commit_message:
Review fixes: mock reaches import-time tasks; queue jobs fail with their cause (#20)

- async_compute looks up the default backend per call, so mock_async also
  reaches functions decorated at import time; it warns when the swapped
  backend drops middleware given to async_compute.
- @async_compute bare detection checks for .launch, not the class, so a
  callable backend (a mock) is not wrapped as the function.
- _au_worker_entrypoint's fallback covers only the task's setup: a failure
  compute_and_record raises now reaches the queue (future, RQ job, Supabase
  status) with its cause, instead of being swallowed and its cause
  overwritten by the write error.
- The unrecordable failure is logged as well as raised; started_at is taken
  right before the call.
- Tests: import-time decoration, a callable backend, the entrypoint; faster
  TTL guard; the mock test writes nowhere outside memory.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
